title: Carbon monoxide
about: Carbon monoxide from fires and pollution, tracked by the GEOS-CF model.
listen: Where the plumes are thickest, the melody gets louder and the chords fill out.

source.label: NASA GMAO / SVS: Air Quality Model Runs

title: Ozone
about: Ozone near the surface, from the same GEOS-CF air quality model.
listen: Patches of high ozone bring the melody in; cleaner air brings rests.

data.when: 15 August 2023, as stamped on the frame

title: Nitrogen oxides
about: Nitrogen oxides from traffic, industry and shipping lanes.
listen: Cities and shipping lanes stand out against clean air as runs of notes.

source.label: NASA GMAO / SVS: Air Quality Model Runs

data.when: 15 August 2023, as stamped on the frame

title: Aerosols
about: Dust, smoke, sea salt and other particles drifting through the atmosphere (GEOS).
listen: Thick dust and smoke make the music louder and busier.

data.from: GEOS model, 2 km GEOS-FP replay (NASA GMAO)

title: Ocean currents
about: Surface currents of the global ocean, coloured by sea temperature (ECCO2 model).
listen: Warm, busy currents bring the melody in; calm, cold water thins it out.

source.label: NASA SVS: Global Sea Surface Currents and Temperature

data.from: ECCO2 ocean model (MIT and NASA JPL)

title: Night lights
about: Earth's cities after dark, seen from space.
listen: Dark oceans fall quiet; bright clusters of cities bring bursts of notes.

source.label: NASA SVS: Change in Night Lights 2012–2023

data.from: VIIRS on the Suomi NPP satellite, Black Marble (NASA and NOAA)

title: Ukraine lights, 2012 → 2023
about: Night lights over Ukraine in 2012, then in 2023, after years of war and power cuts.
listen: Two pieces back to back: listen for the 2023 melody thinning out as the lights go dark.

source.label: NASA SVS: Change in Night Lights 2012–2023

data.from: VIIRS on the Suomi NPP satellite, Black Marble (NASA and NOAA)

title: Atmospheric river
about: A river of moisture in the sky reaching the US west coast, from an Earth system model.
listen: Terrain mode follows the bright cloud bands: higher in the image plays higher notes.

source.label: NASA SVS: A 3D View of an Atmospheric River

data.when: Not given on the source page

title: Forest height
about: Forest canopy height over Africa, measured by the GEDI laser on the ISS.
listen: Terrain mode follows the land: land higher up the image plays higher notes.

data.from: GEDI lidar on the International Space Station

title: Lightning
about: Lightning strikes over a year, detected from the International Space Station (LIS sensor).
listen: Bursts of storms over the tropics come through as sudden notes and drum hits.

source.label: NASA SVS: Lightning Events Detected from the ISS

data.from: Lightning Imaging Sensor on the International Space Station

title: Carbon dioxide
about: Carbon dioxide drifting over western North America in a high-resolution NASA model (DYAMOND).
listen: Where the CO₂ plumes stand out from the background, the melody comes in.

source.label: NASA SVS: DYAMOND Global Carbon Dioxide

title: Perpetual Ocean
about: Ocean currents swirling around the Pacific, from the Perpetual Ocean 2 model run.
listen: Terrain mode follows the land and sea: the melody traces the coastlines around the Pacific.

data.from: ECCO2 ocean and sea-ice model (NASA JPL)
